skeleton: round berry bush facing the viewer, turned a little to the left: root at the woody base's flat bottom (on the ground); trunk (the woody base) on the root; body (pivot where the leaves meet the base) carries the leafy ball (belly, for squash and breathing); a bone at each bunch of berries' stalk so it jiggles; head = the light-green patch in the middle with the face (eyes, brows, mouth), which ducks down behind a clump of leaves (cover) to hide; the cover clump also lies over the bottom of the face at rest.

sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a smiling round berry bush: a ball of green leaves dotted with bunches of shiny red and purple berries, on a short woody base, with a friendly face peeking out of a light-green patch in its middle. Draw this exact bush as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1 (if they do not all fit, draw them all a little smaller, at the same scale as each other).

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the leafy bush WITHOUT berries and without its face: the round ball of green leaves, the same shape, size and leaves as in image 1, but with no berries at all (more leaves where the bunches of berries are) and no face (more leaves in its middle, where the light-green face patch is); without the woody base.
2. the woody base alone: the short brown trunk with its flat rounded bottom, as at the bottom of image 1; its top end, where the leaves cover it, a soft rounded end with no outline drawn across it.
3. the face patch alone: the round, smooth, light yellow-green patch in the middle of image 1 where the face is, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no brows, no mouth — keep the rosy cheeks; its edge soft and leafy.
4. a clump of leaves alone: the little bunch of the bush's leaves that lies over the bottom of the face in image 1, a rounded clump as wide as the face patch.
5. a bunch of four shiny red berries, like the top-left bunch of image 1, on short thin brown stalks joined at the top.
6. a bunch of three shiny red berries, like the bunch at the bottom left of image 1, on short thin brown stalks joined at the top.
7. a bunch of four shiny purple berries, like the bunch at the bottom of image 1, on short thin brown stalks joined at the top.
8. a bunch of three shiny purple berries, like the bunch on the left of image 1, on short thin brown stalks joined at the top.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part. No face on anything but the face patch, and that face blank. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows, no ground, no grass, no loose berries, flying leaves or sparkles. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a smiling round berry bush with a friendly face peeking out of a light-green patch in its middle; image 2 shows the same bush cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the bush's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, a simple, small, friendly cartoon face, every piece at the size it has on the bush in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2. The face is turned a little to the left, and in image 1 both eyes look up and to the left: each glossy dark-brown iris sits towards the upper left of its eye, the white on its lower right, a white sparkle in it.

Draw each piece on its own, upright, in four tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
Row 1, the eye on the LEFT of image 1, five times:
1. as it is in image 1: an oval eye, the dark-brown iris with a white sparkle towards its upper left, the white on its lower right, with a thin dark lid line on top.
2. wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, a ring of white round the iris, looking the same way, with its sparkle.
3. gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line, as wide as the open eye.
4. closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc, like an upside-down U, with two tiny lashes at its outer (left) end.
5. sad: open and round, a soft glossy brown eye with a white sparkle, looking a little down; no lid slanting across it.
Row 2, the eye on the RIGHT of image 1, the same five in the same order, drawn for its own side, never a mirror of row 1; open, it looks the same way as row 1, up and to the left; happy, its lashes at its outer (right) end.
Row 3: 11. the left eyebrow as in image 1, a thin dark-brown arch. 12. the same left eyebrow worried: tilted up at its inner (right) end. 13. the right eyebrow as in image 1, a thin arch. 14. the same right eyebrow worried: tilted up at its inner (left) end.
Row 4, mouths, none with any teeth: 15. the mouth as it is in image 1: a closed happy smile, a thin dark-brown curved line. 16. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside red-pink with a little tongue. 17. the mouth open in a small round 'o', the inside pink. 18. the mouth in a small sad frown. 19. the mouth open in a big sleepy yawn, a tall oval, the inside pink.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the berry bush sprouts: a little woody base pushes up, a round ball of leaves grows and fills out, its berries pop out in bunches, and it smiles.
the berry bush sways gently from side to side in the breeze, its berries swinging, smiling.
the berry bush rustles all its leaves with a shiver, giggling as if tickled.
the berry bush gives itself a good shake so all its berries jiggle and bounce on their stalks, then settles, laughing.
the berry bush droops sadly, sagging low with its berries hanging down, then slowly lifts itself up again.

pause.shows: the berry bush drooping sadly, sagging low

animations.description: the berry bush perks up, puffing up tall and round with its berries bright, eyes wide, and beams.

pause.shows: the berry bush perked up tall and round, beaming

animations.description: the berry bush laughs and laughs, bouncing with giggles, its berries bobbing.
the berry bush gives a big yawn, closes its eyes and nods off to sleep, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.

pause.shows: the berry bush fast asleep, eyes shut, settled low

animations.description: the berry bush gives a cheeky wink and a smile, its face tipping to one side.
the berry bush shyly ducks its face down into its leaves until only leaves show, then peeks back out with a smile.

pause.shows: the berry bush with its face hidden in its leaves
